name: optimiq-voice
description: The complete calling system for modern businesses

scripts.clean: rimraf apps/**/dist packages/**/dist apps/**/node_modules packages/**/node_modules node_modules .turbo
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/db run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/pbx-db run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/cdr-db run db:generate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/db run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/pbx-db run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/cdr-db run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run db:deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run seed:pbx && pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run seed:cdr
scripts.start:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=development LOGS_LEVEL=verbose pnpm --filter @optimiq-voice/api run start:dev
scripts.start:services: cross-env docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up postgres nats asterisk adminer mailhog -d --remove-orphans
scripts.stop:services: cross-env docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.test: cross-env LOG_LEVEL=silent LOG_PRETTY=false LOGS_LEVEL=none NODE_ENV=development mocha --timeout 30000 --ignore 'apps/**/*.integration.test.ts' --ignore 'packages/**/*.integration.test.ts' 'apps/**/*.test.ts' 'packages/**/*.test.ts'
